counterfactual_text: The sponge regains its original shape while the hand is still pressing it, and the hand lifts afterward.
positive_text: The hand compresses the sponge until visibly flattened, lifts away, and the same sponge then expands gradually toward its original shape.
semantic_text: A hand presses a dry sponge flat, then lifts away as the same sponge gradually regains its shape. Initial scene: A fixed side three-quarter view of one dry sponge resting uncompressed on a flat surface, with one open hand hovering just above its center. The full hand, complete sponge outline, original sponge thickness, space between hand and sponge, and surrounding open area are clearly visible under neutral lighting. Required visible entities: one hand; one dry sponge; flat support surface. At the beginning: sponge: dry, intact, uncompressed, and at its original thickness; hand: open, hovering above the sponge, and spatially separated. Required layout: hand center aligns with the sponge center; small visible space separates hand and sponge; full sponge thickness, contact area, and hand fit inside the frame. Required state changes: sponge thickness: original to flattened; hand contact: hovering to pressing to lifted; sponge shape: compressed to gradually recovered. These event variables are allowed to change: hand vertical position and contact state; sponge thickness and shape; sponge recovery progress. Preserve throughout: static side three-quarter camera; sponge identity, color, and dry material appearance; flat surface and background; one hand; one dry sponge; the same sponge and support surface.
